WITH channel_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(f.feerate) AS channel_avg
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(channel_avg) AS bench_value
  FROM channel_avgs
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.channel_avg,
    ca.channel_avg - b.bench_value AS excess
  FROM channel_avgs ca
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE ca.channel_avg > b.bench_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(channel_avg) AS mean_of_channel_avgs,
  AVG(excess) AS mean_of_excess_above_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark
